title: Zesty Russian Oat Milk Batter
description: A buttery, aerated brunch dish featuring oat milk, made with a mortar and pestle, perfect for a low-glycemic morning treat.
instructions: In a mortar and pestle, grind the granulated sugar substitute into a fine powder.
Add the unsalted butter to the mortar and pestle, pound until creamy and smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the oat milk and eggs.
Add the ground sugar substitute and butter mixture to the bowl, whisk until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and vanilla extract.
Add the flour mixture to the oat milk mixture, whisk until just combined.
Gently fold in the plain Greek yogurt.
Pour the batter into a greased 9-inch round baking dish or cake pan.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
